description: This Java class defines a condition for handling remote job message handlers in the Fineract framework, checking configuration properties to determine if certain conditions are met for enabling message handlers and batch processing.

classes.name: FineractRemoteJobMessageHandlerCondition
classes.description: A condition class that evaluates configuration properties to determine if remote job message handlers are correctly configured for batch processing in Fineract.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the method to evaluate if the current properties meet the conditions for remote job message handling.

methods.name: isOnlyOneMessageHandlerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if exactly one message handler (Spring Events or JMS) is enabled.

methods.name: isAnyMessageHandlerConfigured
methods.description: Checks if at least one message handler (Spring Events or JMS) is enabled.

methods.name: isBatchInstance
methods.description: Determines if the current instance is configured as a batch manager or worker.

methods.name: isBatchManagerAndWorkerTogether
methods.description: Checks if both batch manager and worker modes are enabled simultaneously.
